editorialSummary.heading: An extra Friday before Thanksgiving and a separate Good Friday holiday
paragraphs: Gadsden students are out Friday, November 20, 2026, for planning and professional learning before Thanksgiving week begins. The named fall break is November 23-27, so families have a continuous November 20-29 stretch away from regular classes when both weekends are included. Winter time off follows the December 18 half day. The holiday dates run December 21 through New Year’s Day, with another student-free planning day January 4. Students return Tuesday, January 5. Those adjacent planning days matter when arranging care at the beginning and end of a vacation.

Spring break runs March 15-19, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume March 22. Students have four regular school days before the separate March 26 Good Friday holiday; the two breaks do not form one continuous vacation. The year opens Tuesday, August 11, and finishes Wednesday, May 26, a half day. The student calendar also marks December 18 as a half day, but gives no dismissal times. Check the school’s pickup schedule, particularly for March 5, where the student and bus calendars use different wording.
highlights: Thanksgiving time off begins with the November 20 planning day.
January 5 is the published winter return.
March 22-25 is a regular school week between spring break and Good Friday.

about.dataSource: The primary source is the first-page 2026-2027 Student Calendar in the district’s eight-page ALL CALENDARS PDF. It prints Approved January 27, 2026. The supplied local PDF and the current download linked from the district homepage and Support Services page have the same SHA-256.
about.processing: All eight scanned pages were rendered and visually reviewed. Page 1 controls the student schedule; pages 2-8 cover teachers, administrators, other employee groups, bus drivers and food service. Employee report dates, FTE surveys, paid-holiday counts, pre/postplanning and post-year Memorial Day are omitted from student events. No semester or report-card dates are inferred. There is no printed annual student total; 207 weekdays minus 28 explicit no-class weekdays gives a derived baseline of 179 attendance dates, counting half days as attendance. The bus drivers/aides page labels March 5 Half Day, while the student and teacher pages list only the third grading-period ending. Keep one grading milestone with a dismissal-confirmation note; do not assert a confirmed student half day or invent a closure. The disagreement concerns dismissal, not whether that date has attendance, and does not require an attendanceUncertaintyDates entry. The 2025-26 Bells & Buses document still linked from the homepage is not evidence for 2026-27 clock times. Named holidays stay separate from derived continuous spans; March 22-25 is not bridged into a vacation. No make-up dates or activation rules are invented.
about.updates: The current calendar download, homepage, full current news listing, Support Services and Transportation pages were checked October 19, 2026. No later student-calendar revision or notice resolving March 5 dismissal was verified. Check district and school announcements for weather closures, attendance changes and school-specific transportation arrangements.
about.disclaimer: This is an independent reference for families following the district student calendar. Confirm dismissal times, separate programs, childcare, bus arrangements and later changes directly with your school.

faqs.question: When does school start in Gadsden County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. The earlier August dates in the combined PDF are employee workdays.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is a half day and the end of the fourth grading period. Check your school’s dismissal time before arranging pickup or care.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, including the Friday before it?
faqs.answer: Students are out Friday, November 20, 2026, for planning and professional learning. Thanksgiving Holidays/Fall Break runs November 23-27. Together with the weekends, that gives students November 20-29 away from regular classes, with a scheduled return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January?
faqs.answer: Christmas/Winter Holidays are December 21-31, 2026, followed by New Year’s Day on January 1, 2027. January 4 is a student-free planning and professional-learning day. Students return Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, the continuous time away from regular classes runs December 19-January 4; December 18 is a half day.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Including both weekends, students are scheduled away from regular classes March 13-21, with classes resuming Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Does spring break continue through Good Friday?
faqs.answer: No. March 22-25 are regular scheduled school days after spring break. Good Friday, March 26, 2027, is a separate district holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29, after that holiday weekend.

faqs.question: Which planning and professional-learning days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: The student-free dates are October 12 and November 20, 2026, and January 4, 2027. These are full days without student classes. The planning time mentioned in employee calendars on December 18 and May 26 does not turn those student half days into full days off.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day or Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, and Wednesday, November 11, are district holidays with no student classes. The calendar does not list November 12 or 13 as additional holidays.

faqs.question: Are schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on Monday, January 18, 2027, for Martin Luther King Jr. Day, and Monday, February 15, for Presidents Day. Both are listed as district holidays.

faqs.question: Which dates are confirmed student half days?
faqs.answer: The Student Calendar explicitly lists December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027, as half days. Students attend on both dates. March 5 has different wording elsewhere in the combined PDF, so confirm that day’s dismissal separately.

faqs.question: Is March 5, 2027, a half day for students?
faqs.answer: The student and teacher calendars list March 5 as the end of the third grading period. The bus drivers and aides calendar labels it Half Day. Confirm dismissal with your school and transportation before making pickup plans; the student calendar does not confirm a half day on that date.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on half days?
faqs.answer: The student calendar does not give dismissal times. Ask your school for its 2026-2027 half-day schedule and confirm the afternoon bus or pickup time. The district Transportation Department can be reached at 850-627-6858.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four endings are October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 5 and May 26, 2027. December 18 and May 26 are explicitly marked half days. A grading-period ending by itself does not mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: When will report cards be available?
faqs.answer: The student calendar lists grading-period endings but does not give report-card release dates. Check school messages and the district’s FOCUS parent portal for grades and report-card information.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are on the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates produce 179 scheduled student attendance dates: 207 weekdays from August 11 through May 26, minus 28 no-class weekdays. This is a calculation from the calendar, not a district-printed annual total. Half days count as attendance dates; the employee day counts elsewhere in the PDF are separate.

faqs.question: Which dates are reserved for hurricane make-up days?
faqs.answer: The Student Calendar does not identify specific make-up dates or an order for using holidays. Watch district and school announcements after a closure before changing travel or childcare plans.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for updates?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF button or the CALENDARS section of the district’s Support Services page. The download includes separate student and employee calendars; the Student Calendar is the first page. Check district news and school messages for later changes.
